Duskull

Ghost

Hoenn · Generation 3

Duskull is a Ghost-type Requiem Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 15 kg. It evolves into Dusclops. Its highest base stat is Defense (90), with a base stat total of 295.
